item_short_desc: Rothco’s Nylon Paracord 550lb 600 Ft Spool is a versatile and essential tool for outdoor enthusiasts, campers, and survivalists. Crafted with a 7-strand core and tested to hold up to 550 lbs of weight, this high-quality parachute cord is strong, durable, and reliable in a variety of challenging situations. Made from 100% nylon with a 5/32 inch diameter, it’s lightweight and easy to carry while being tough enough to withstand rugged use.
description: Rothco’s Nylon Paracord 550lb 600 Ft Spool is a versatile and essential tool for outdoor enthusiasts, campers, and survivalists. Crafted with a 7-strand core and tested to hold up to 550 lbs of weight, this high-quality parachute cord is strong, durable, and reliable in a variety of challenging situations. Made from 100% nylon with a 5/32 inch diameter, it’s lightweight and easy to carry while being tough enough to withstand rugged use. Whether you're securing gear, setting up a shelter, or creating bracelets and keychains, this paracord is the ideal companion for any outdoor adventure. The 600 feet of cord packed into each spool provides more than enough length to handle a range of projects and emergency situations. Proudly made in the USA by a certified U.S. Government Contractor, Rothco’s Paracord delivers premium performance you can trust. Whether for camping, hunting, or everyday preparedness, this paracord is designed to tackle it all.
